scope: Uncommitted tree; current source hashes and commands in recurrence-operations-validation.json
rubric: Same six equally weighted categories. Sum 52, mean 8.6667, half-up rounded to 8.7. Engineering judgment, not certification.

categories.name: Security and access control
categories.reason: Authenticated merchant recurrence terms, single-use base mandates and atomic agent occurrence caps join existing signature/cart/replay checks. Live custody remains unqualified.

categories.name: Observability and diagnosability
categories.reason: Reference HTTP host emits bounded metrics; storage failure and backlog signals fire. Prometheus storage, backlog and latency rule firing/recovery tests pass. Production instrumentation and pager delivery remain open.

categories.name: Reliability and scale
categories.reason: Budget and occurrence races, reconciliation rollback, replay and uncertain commit pass. Real backup/restore preserves the complete ledger snapshot; broad production load and PITR are not qualified.

categories.name: Configuration and data
categories.reason: Idempotent terminal reconciliation, preserved replay/count state, legacy schema migration and unknown legacy ages are tested. External journal authentication and stale-backup recovery remain host responsibilities.

categories.name: Deployment and release
categories.reason: Local tests, lint, ABI and alert gates pass and are wired into workflows. Changes remain uncommitted; hosted validation and a release for this tree are still outstanding.

categories.name: Testing and documentation
categories.reason: 50 intent tests, expanded conformance profile, real PostgreSQL restore and nine Prometheus evaluations pass. Full cross-stack conformance and wider SDK branch coverage remain incomplete.

arithmetic_correction: Historical pre-budget HTML displayed 8.3 although its categories averaged 8.1667 (8.2). The subsequent 8.4 assessment and current 8.7 use directly computed means.
